conflicts.description: Conflict between strict type safety and permissive dynamic typing
conflicts.rule_a: 1. Always use strict typing and strict mode in all modules.
conflicts.rule_b: 2. For scripts and rapid prototyping, allow any to save time.

conflicts.description: Conflict between functional programming and object-oriented class hierarchies
conflicts.rule_a: 3. Always structure code with functional composition and avoid classes.
conflicts.rule_b: 4. All services must inherit from BaseService class hierarchy.
